description: This class represents a secret for PSK (Pre-Shared Key) credentials in the Hono service management context. It extends CommonSecret and manages a byte array key used for PSK authentication, including validation to ensure the key is set.

classes.name: PskSecret
classes.description: Encapsulates PSK secret information, including validation of the secret key.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the secret key byte array.

methods.name: setKey
methods.description: Sets the secret key byte array and returns this object for method chaining.

methods.name: toStringHelper
methods.description: Provides a ToStringHelper instance for generating string representation of the object, including the key.

methods.name: checkValidity
methods.description: Validates that the key is set and not empty; throws an exception if invalid.
